payload.title: Kubernetes Deployment metrics

data_source.query:
TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Node == "" OR ?Node == ".*" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?Node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?Node)))
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR labels.pod IS NULL OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.container_memory_working_set_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.machine_memory_bytes IS NOT NULL
| STATS used = SUM(CASE(labels.pod IS NOT NULL, LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.container_memory_working_set_bytes), NULL)), total = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.machine_memory_bytes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL computed_value = CASE(total > 0, used / total, NULL)
| WHERE computed_value IS NOT NULL
| SORT time_bucket DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.container_memory_working_set_bytes IS NOT NULL AND labels.pod IS NOT NULL
| STATS computed_value = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.container_memory_working_set_bytes))
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Node == "" OR ?Node == ".*" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?Node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?Node)))
| WHERE metrics.container_memory_working_set_bytes IS NOT NULL
| STATS computed_value = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.container_memory_working_set_bytes))
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Node == "" OR ?Node == ".*" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?Node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?Node)))
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR labels.pod IS NULL OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.machine_cpu_cores IS NOT NULL
| STATS used = SUM(CASE(labels.pod IS NOT NULL, RATE(metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total), NULL)), total = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.machine_cpu_cores)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL computed_value = CASE(total > 0, used / total, NULL)
| WHERE computed_value IS NOT NULL
| SORT time_bucket DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total IS NOT NULL AND labels.pod IS NOT NULL
| STATS computed_value = SUM(RATE(metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE computed_value IS NOT NULL
| SORT time_bucket DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Node == "" OR ?Node == ".*" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?Node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?Node)))
| WHERE metrics.machine_cpu_cores IS NOT NULL
| STATS computed_value = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.machine_cpu_cores))
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR (labels.deployment RLIKE ?Deployment OR (labels.deployment IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas_available IS NOT NULL OR metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas IS NOT NULL
| STATS available = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas_available)), total = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL computed_value = CASE(total > 0, available / total, NULL)
| WHERE computed_value IS NOT NULL
| SORT time_bucket DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR (labels.deployment RLIKE ?Deployment OR (labels.deployment IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas_available IS NOT NULL
| STATS computed_value = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas_available))
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR (labels.deployment RLIKE ?Deployment OR (labels.deployment IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas IS NOT NULL
| STATS computed_value = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas))

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total IS NOT NULL AND labels.pod IS NOT NULL
| STATS value = SUM(RATE(metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.pod
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.pod`, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total IS NOT NULL AND labels.container IS NOT NULL AND labels.container != "POD"
| STATS value = SUM(RATE(metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.pod, labels.container
| EVAL series_group = CONCAT(COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.pod`), ""), " / ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.container`), ""))
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.pod`, `labels.container`, value, series_group
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total IS NOT NULL AND labels.id IS NOT NULL AND labels.id != "/"
| STATS value = SUM(RATE(metrics.container_cpu_usage_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.id
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.id`, value

| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend

| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE metrics.container_memory_working_set_bytes IS NOT NULL AND labels.id IS NOT NULL AND labels.id != "/"
| STATS value = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.container_memory_working_set_bytes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.id
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.id`, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE labels.pod IS NOT NULL AND (metrics.container_network_receive_bytes_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.container_network_transmit_bytes_total IS NOT NULL)
| STATS Received = SUM(RATE(metrics.container_network_receive_bytes_total)), Sent = 0 - SUM(RATE(metrics.container_network_transmit_bytes_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.pod
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.pod`, Received, Sent
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?Deployment == "" OR ?Deployment == ".*" OR STARTS_WITH(TO_STRING(labels.pod), TO_STRING(?Deployment)))
| WHERE labels.id IS NOT NULL AND labels.id != "/" AND (metrics.container_network_receive_bytes_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.container_network_transmit_bytes_total IS NOT NULL)
| STATS Received = SUM(RATE(metrics.container_network_receive_bytes_total)), Sent = 0 - SUM(RATE(metrics.container_network_transmit_bytes_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.id
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.id`, Received, Sent
| SORT time_bucket ASC

payload.description: Monitors Kubernetes deployments in cluster using Prometheus. Shows overall cluster CPU / Memory of deployments, replicas in each deployment. Uses Kube state metrics and cAdvisor metrics

config.title: Deployment
config.esql_query: FROM metrics-k8s.prometheus-default | WHERE `metrics.kube_deployment_status_replicas` IS NOT NULL AND `labels.deployment` IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY `labels.deployment` | EVAL options = MV_APPEND(".*", `labels.deployment`) | MV_EXPAND options | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY options | KEEP options | RENAME options AS `labels.deployment` | SORT `labels.deployment` ASC | LIMIT 1000

config.title: Node
config.esql_query: FROM metrics-k8s.prometheus-default | WHERE `metrics.machine_cpu_cores` IS NOT NULL AND `labels.instance` IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY `labels.instance` | EVAL options = MV_APPEND(".*", `labels.instance`) | MV_EXPAND options | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY options | KEEP options | RENAME options AS `labels.instance` | SORT `labels.instance` ASC | LIMIT 1000
